pages.text: The Canner pours liquid into fuel cells: $(4)10,000 mb per cell$(0), filling at 1,000 mb/tick and $(bold)free of charge$(0).$(br2)Fully automatic: empty cell in → filled → full cell out. Hook up fluid and item pipes and it runs unattended.

$(bold)What to can:$(0) the Nether Compound / Pure fuel from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l) and the Advanced / Ultimate Mixture from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).$(br2)Carry the filled cells straight to the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l); chasing the top tier? Blend it in the Mixer first.
Overview in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l); the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l) is where the cells get burned.
